title: Show, Don’t Tell: Uncovering Implicit Character Portrayal using LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting an LLM to insert disability-related demographic information (e.g., physically-disabled, able-bodied) into anonymized narrative texts, and measuring the resulting accuracy disparities and variance in implicit character portrayal classification.

Prompting an LLM to insert religious demographic information (e.g., Jewish, Christian, Atheist) into anonymized narrative texts, and measuring the resulting accuracy disparities and variance in implicit character portrayal classification.

Prompting an LLM to insert racial demographic information (e.g., African, Hispanic, Asian, Caucasian) into anonymized narrative texts, and measuring the resulting accuracy disparities and variance in implicit character portrayal classification.

Prompting an LLM to insert gender demographic information (e.g., man, woman, transgender man, transgender woman, non-binary) into anonymized narrative texts, and measuring the resulting accuracy disparities and variance in implicit character portrayal classification.

Prompting an LLM to insert political affiliation demographic information (e.g., lifelong Democrat, lifelong Republican) into anonymized narrative texts, and measuring the resulting accuracy disparities and variance in implicit character portrayal classification.
